pull.body:
Closes #31.

## Summary

The first round answered issue #31 with a dedicated Re-engage screen. The [review](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/pull/34#issuecomment-6111692095) asked for a universal, configurable mechanism instead, so this round replaces that screen with **automations**. Issue #31 becomes one preset (`reengage-dormant`) of that mechanism. The detection core from round 1 is kept.

An automation is **trigger → audience → conditions → action**. The triggers follow [konard/vk-bot](https://github.com/konard/vk-bot): `manual`, `schedule`, `incoming` (regex) and `chat-menu`. Safe mode (alias `debug`) is the default: a run only queues pre-filled drafts in each person's own chat. A draft is sent only after a confirmation, which the server enforces.

## Every requirement, where it lives

The full mapping, sentence by sentence, is in [`docs/case-studies/issue-31/requirements.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/requirements.md). Section X of `docs/REQUIREMENTS.md` (R-X1 … R-X21) has the short form.

| Asked for | Delivered |
| --- | --- |
| Issue: contacts silent ≥ 90 days, the two texts, ты/вы auto-detected by regex, our own rules | `reengage-dormant` preset, `silentDays: 90`. `crm/address-form.js` uses Unicode-aware word rules, and the owner's messages weigh twice. A tie or no evidence falls back to "вы". `pattern:*` links labelled `address:informal/formal` add rules. |
| Issue: safe or debug mode, one prefilled message at a time, sent after confirmation | `safe` (alias `debug`) is the default for every automation. Drafts appear in the chat and are sent from it or from `automations review`. `/api/automations/drafts/send` refuses without `confirm: true`. |
| Triggers as in vk-bot instead of a separate screen; no separate chat | `automation/automations.js` handles manual, schedule, incoming and chat-menu triggers, and a scheduler starts with the server. The Re-engage screen, the `reengage` command and `/api/reengage/*` were removed. |
| Universal and configurable, also for jobs and contracts | The **Automation** tab creates, edits, previews, runs and deletes any automation. Presets: `reengage-dormant`, `job-search`, `contract-search`, `greet-back`. |
| Searchable, cross-referenced people; audiences merged and intersected from lists, communities and chats | `crm/people.js` keeps one entry per account. `sameAs` links join accounts; `crossReference` only suggests matches and never merges. Audiences combine `friends`, `chat:`, `community:`, `list:`, `person:`, `audience:` and `q:` atoms by union, `&` and `-`. VK and Telegram members are synced as `member:` links. |
| Conditions such as 90 days | Conditions: `silentDays`, `mutual`, `personal`, `lastFrom`, `networks`, `cooldownDays`. The preview names why each person was left out. |
| Test from the menu of any private or group chat | The ⚡ menu in every chat header has "Test in this chat" (conditions ignored) and "Run with its conditions". |
| Reply autocomplete: deduplicated, sorted by frequency, word-by-word fallback from our own messages, link-cli | `replies/reply-graph.js` learns prompt → reply pairs from the archive and in real time. Suggestions are sorted by use count; the fallback chain is trigram → bigram → unigram over the owner's messages. The graph is mirrored to `clink --serve` (`MS_REPLY_CLINK=1`); keystrokes are answered from memory because a link-cli query scans every link (see "Alternatives" in the plan). |
| Associative stack: Links Notation text and binary, link-cli database | `storage/lino-store.js` stores the text form. `storage/binary-packet.js` and `doublets-archive.js` write binary packets in the link-cli archive layout; tests cross-check them against `links-notation`. |
| Typing status in all messengers | VK `messages.setActivity`, Telegram `sendChatAction`, WhatsApp typing indicators and the web UIs. VK long-poll events show when the other person is typing. An automation types for as long as the text would take before it sends. |
| t3.codes-like React chat, Telegram-like option, dark/light/system/auto themes, several skins | React 19 chat with a searchable sidebar grouped by date and a floating composer. Skins: t3 (default), Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal. Themes: system, light, dark and auto (by hour), under Settings → Appearance. |
| Lessons from hh-job-application-automation | Daily cap, random pauses, the `automation-run:*` de-duplication ledger, and confirmation before sending. |
| Browser fallback via browser-commander | `sources/browser-sender.js` drives vk.com, web.telegram.org and web.whatsapp.com when the API throws or is not configured. A signed-out page is reported as `login-required`. |
| Update every dependency | Every npm package and GitHub Action is on its latest release, with fixes for ESLint 10 and jscpd 5. |

The same automations are available from the CLI (`meta-sovereign automations list/plan/run/review/drafts/history/save/delete`) and over HTTP (`/api/automations*`, `/api/people`, `/api/audiences`, `/api/suggest`). Docs are updated in en/ru/zh/hi: USER-GUIDE section 11, REQUIREMENTS section X and SERVER-PARITY section 5a. Main's Greetings feature (#35) was merged in, and both features work side by side.

## Screenshots

These are Playwright screenshots of `experiments/automations-spa-server.mjs`, a seeded store whose senders are fakes that only log.

Issue 31's draft in the person's own chat, with the ⚡ Automations menu:

![automation menu](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/chat-automation-menu.png?raw=true)

Whole-reply suggestions: "Как дела?" was answered before, and the answer used twice comes first.

![reply suggestions](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/chat-reply-suggestions.png?raw=true)

Word-by-word fallback, learnt from the owner's own messages:

![word suggestions](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/chat-word-suggestions.png?raw=true)

The automation editor with its preview: who gets which form, and why the others are left out.

![editor and preview](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/automations-editor-preview.png?raw=true)

Settings → Appearance (themes and skins). There are 8 skin and theme captures in [`screenshots/`](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/tree/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots).

![appearance](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/settings-appearance.png?raw=true)

Phones and tablets use Material 3 window-size classes: a bottom bar with a "More" sheet on a 390 px phone, and a navigation rail on an 800 px tablet (shown in Russian).

| Phone: chats | Phone: issue 31's draft | Phone: contacts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![phone chats](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/phone-chat-list.png?raw=true) | ![phone draft](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/phone-chat-draft.png?raw=true) | ![phone contacts](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/phone-contacts.png?raw=true) |

| Phone: "More" sheet | Phone: automation editor (ru) |
| --- | --- |
| ![more sheet](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/phone-more-sheet.png?raw=true) | ![automation ru](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/phone-automation-ru.png?raw=true) |

![tablet rail, Russian](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/screenshots/tablet-chat-rail-ru.png?raw=true)

## UI/UX review round

This round followed the [latest review](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/pull/34#issuecomment-6111692095) ("every element in every place perfectly aligned, screen space used wisely"). The web app, the desktop shell and the download page were all checked.

- **Audit tooling.** `experiments/ui-audit.mjs` visits every view at desktop, tablet and phone widths, in light and dark, with `LOCALE=en` and `LOCALE=ru`. It reports horizontal overflow, clipped or ellipsised labels, controls under WCAG 2.2's 24×24 px target, overlapping controls, uneven rows and axe-core contrast violations. The last runs report no layout findings. The only finding left is four failed `vk.com` sticker requests (`ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR`) from external demo images. `experiments/issue-31-screenshots.mjs` regenerates every shot above.
- **Wording** (Material 3 and Apple HIG): sentence case for buttons, headings and meta lines; plurals in each language (ICU subset); and `Intl` dates in the interface language. Networks appear by name ("VK", "Telegram", "Email", or "Почта" in Russian) instead of internal ids. Untouched preset automations show their name and description in the user's language.
- **Chat list dates.** Rows show the time today, the weekday within the week, and the date after that, as messengers do. Before, a months-old chat showed only a time ("4:10 AM").
- **Suggestions.** The word fallback shows three chips, like the Gboard and iOS QuickType strip, instead of eight. Whole replies used before are all still offered.
- **Contacts.** Each contact is named by its messages (`senderName`; "Аня user1001" instead of "user1001"). The list is newest first and excludes the owner. The offline client returns the same list as `/api/contacts`.
- **Desktop app.** The window opens in the app's own background colour instead of flashing white on a dark desktop. It is shown on `ready-to-show` and can be narrowed only to a phone's width (360 px), where the app switches to its bottom bar.
- **Download page.** A card's size no longer wraps onto a line that starts with "·".

## How to try

```bash
node experiments/automations-spa-server.mjs 4791     # open http://localhost:4791
node experiments/automations-cli-roundtrip.mjs       # plan → safe run → review → plan again, on disk
meta-sovereign automations plan reengage-dormant     # preview from the CLI
```

## Tests

`npm test` passes 839/839 locally (Node), and `i18n` also passes on Bun and Deno. Lint, Prettier and jscpd (5.1 %) pass too. New test files: `automations`, `automation-cli`, `automations-server`, `automation-api`, `automations-view`, `people`, `live-links`, `reply-graph`, `reply-service`, `reply-store-clink`, `doublets-archive`, `browser-sender`, `chat-view`, `appearance`, `aggregate` and `desktop-window`. `address-form`, `reengage`, `i18n` and `download-page` were extended. `experiments/merged-spa-smoke.mjs` opens the Chat, Automation and Greetings tabs in Chromium with no console errors.

CI passes on the full Node / Bun / Deno × Ubuntu / macOS / Windows matrix. Two CI-only problems were fixed on the way:
- **Windows:** `findClink` now looks for `clink.exe`, and its test builds paths with the host separator.
- **Bun on macOS:** Bun uses the system's newer CLDR data there. It joins date and time with "at" / "в" and capitalises Russian weekdays, so the date tests accept both forms.
- **Deno:** Deno 2 refuses npm releases younger than 24 h, so the `links-notation` and `lino-objects-codec` ranges start at `0.25.0` and `0.9.0`. The lockfile still installs the latest 0.25.2 and 0.9.2.

## Known limits

- Only VK reports when the other person is typing. The Telegram Bot API and WhatsApp Cloud API deliver no typing events, and WhatsApp can show typing only in reply to an incoming message.
- Web-UI sending depends on each site's markup. It is tested against a fake browser session, not against the live sites.
- The link-cli mirror needs the `clink` binary and is off unless `MS_REPLY_CLINK=1`.
- With three or more SPA tabs in one sync room, the console shows WebRTC "Failed to set remote answer sdp: Called in wrong state". `sync/webrtc-transport.js` broadcasts offers and answers to every peer; this predates the PR and is unchanged by it.
- The Rust server does not implement the automation, people and suggestion routes yet. Route parity is now 34 of 67 routes (51 %); see SERVER-PARITY section 5a.

Case study: [`docs/case-studies/issue-31/`](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/tree/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31). The changeset is `.changeset/issue-31-automations.md` (minor).

## Working session summary

I've finished issue #31: the app can now find personal contacts you haven't talked to for 90+ days and prepare the right message for each. PR #34 is ready for review, CI passes (including tests on node, bun and deno across Linux, macOS and Windows), and it can be merged cleanly: https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/pull/34

**What it does**
- **Finding contacts:** it looks for one-to-one chats with no message for at least 90 days, in either direction. Groups, channels and bots are left out, and you must have written to the person at least once, so unanswered spam doesn't count.
- **"ты" or "вы":** a set of word-level regex rules decides which form the dialog used. Your own messages count twice, because the new message is yours.
  - The screen shows the evidence for the guess and lets you flip it with one click or key.
  - A tie or no evidence falls back to "вы", which is safer than an unexpected "ты".
  - On "our rules": you can add your own rules as patterns labelled informal or formal, with no code changes.
- **Texts:** the two texts from the issue are the defaults. You can replace them, and `{name}` is filled in with the contact's name.
- **Safe mode is the default everywhere:** one prefilled, editable message at a time, sent only after you confirm. A failed send stays on the same message.
  - "Send all" exists only when you switch safe mode off, and it still asks once.
  - In the API, the batch route refuses unless you pass `mode: "batch"` and `confirm: true`.
- **Three ways to use it:**
  - a new **Re-engage** screen in the app;
  - `meta-sovereign reengage`, with `--interactive` to go one by one;
  - HTTP routes: `/api/reengage/plan`, `/send`, `/mark` and `/run`.
- **No repeats:** every send, skip and failure is remembered, so the same person isn't offered again until another 90 days pass.
- **Manual sending:** where the app can't send, each message has Copy, an "Open chat" link and "I sent it myself".

**Checks.** Locally, all 551 tests pass, along with lint, formatting and the duplication check; the logs are saved in the case study folder. I tested the screen in a real browser against a demo server with a fake sender, covering sending, skipping, a failed send and "Send all". The four screenshots are in the PR description.

**Things you should know**
- **Server:** sending from the app needs the JS server. The Rust server doesn't have these routes; that gap is recorded in the server-parity doc. Without a server, the list and the manual-send options still work.
- **Telegram:** imported contacts are numeric ids, so "Open chat" opens the chat but can't prefill the text. Telegram's documented `t.me/<username>?text=` link would allow it once an importer records usernames. I also haven't checked how real Telegram apps handle these id-based links.
- **VK:** VK's official docs couldn't be fetched from here, so the rule for telling personal chats from group chats is cross-checked only against community sources, such as [this Habr answer](https://qna.habr.com/q/604802) and [the vk-io helpers reference](https://www.mintlify.com/negezor/vk-io/api-reference/helpers).
- **Languages:** detection rules ship for Russian, Chinese and Hindi only. Others, like German du/Sie, can be added as patterns.
- **Moved folder:** `docs/case-studies/issue-31/` already held a case study about the pipeline template's issue 31. I moved it unchanged to `docs/case-studies/pipeline-template-issue-31/` to make room for this one.

I also added the requirements, a new user-guide section and server-parity notes, all in English, Russian, Chinese and Hindi. Alongside them are a case study in `docs/case-studies/issue-31/` and a changeset for a minor release.

Instead of separate screen for it we should make it like scheduler or manual trigger, see triggers concept from https://github.com/konard/vk-bot

We don't need separate chat for or screen, just regular chat is enough.

So that should be part of preexisting features. We should focus on producing more universal configurable solutions, not specific features that are not changeable by user.

Yet such talking strategy can help user find jobs or contracts.

In chat we should use our message to massage database (which should be learnable from vk archive or API or real time in dialogs).

We should use latest associative stack for all the systems and especially for storage, import and export (text + binary) links notation, and for fast search and access - link-cli database.

https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/main/docs/associative-tech-stack.md - here details.

We need update exactly all dependencies we have.

Also take best experience from https://github.com/konard/hh-job-application-automation

So the idea for this is automations.

Automation can be triggered manually on selected users (which should be searchable, and cross referenced), for example we can search for audiences - each audience can be merged from lists, communities, chats and so on, for example we can configure intersect multiple lists of users to make sure we have exactly people we need.

And for such audience we can trigger the automation.

Automation can be triggered for all friends, people from chat, community and so on directly with conditions, like we only send hi/hello to users we didn't talked for 90 days.

Automation can also be triggered via menu inside each private chat or group chat to test it.

We also need to make sure we use message to message (replies mapping) for autocomplete, if single message has multiple possible answers we used before we show deduplicated list of them sorted by frequency of previous usage for each message to message reply link.

For that link-cli should be used, to do it fast.

If no messages directly match last message in the chat, we can do autocomplete word by word based on our message history by default only by our own messages.

So we try first autocomplete by entire message, if no matches we go to word by word autocomplete, so we speed up user's typing time.

We also must fully support typing status in all messangers, meaning when user or automation is typing we show that status for that again see https://github.com/konard/vk-bot

The style of default UI/UX for chats should be closer to https://t3.codes with option to switch to telegram like theme (source code also is present on the internet), prefer to reuse best practices and not reinvent the wheel, yet we still need everything to be in React.js

So we need automatic dark/light/system or auto themes, and multiple supported skins based on best messaging apps we have source code of.

Double check exactly all my requirements are fully delivered.

We also need to make our message sending/receiving fully advanced, so if we cannot do it directly via API, we should use official web UI of VK, telegram and others via our https://github.com/link-foundation/browser-commander, so if API fails or not available we fallback to sending via browser.
